name: Face X-Ray Boundary
description: Detects blending boundaries using Face X-Ray technique (Li et al., 2020)
algorithm: Face X-Ray Boundary — 픽셀 수준 공간 분석
mechanism:
This method implements the Face X-ray technique from Li et al. (2020) for general face forgery detection:

1. **블렌딩경계Hypothesis**: Face X-ray is based on the key insight that most face manipulation methods share a common step — blending a modified face region onto a background. This blending creates a detectable boundary even when the face modification itself is imperceptible. The method targets this universal blending step rather than specific manipulation artifacts.

2. **Gray-Scale블렌딩Map추정**: For each pixel, the method estimates whether it belongs to a blending boundary. The "face X-ray" is computed as a map B(x) indicating the probability that pixel x is at a face blending boundary. This is estimated using the observation that blended regions show HR (high-resolution) content from the face source mixed with LR (low-resolution) content from the background at boundaries.

3. **Multi-Scale경계감지**: The face X-ray is computed at multiple scales to detect blending at different resolutions. Blending boundaries may be sharp (simple alpha compositing) or smooth (Poisson blending, feathered masks), requiring multi-scale analysis for robust detection.

4. **Cross-색상-Space분석**: The blending boundary signature is analyzed in multiple color spaces (RGB, YCbCr, HSV). Different color channels may show blending artifacts with varying intensity — YCbCr chrominance channels are particularly sensitive to blending artifacts that are invisible in luminance.

5. **시간적X-ray일관성**: The face X-ray map is computed per frame and tracked temporally. A persistent blending boundary at consistent facial locations across frames provides strong evidence of face manipulation. The temporal stability of the X-ray signal increases detection confidence and reduces false positives from compression artifacts or natural skin boundaries.
parameters:
분석 유형: 픽셀
미디어: 비디오
입력: Video frames extracted at key intervals
출력: 신뢰도 점수 (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: 중간~높음 — 70-88% 단독 정확도. Most effective when combined with other 비디오 forensic methods. Performance depends on 비디오 quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated 비디오 through face x-ray boundary analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for 비디오 authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captures temporal artifacts that single-frame analysis misses
• Works with standard 비디오 formats
• Effective against common deepfake techniques
• Can be combined with other 비디오 forensic methods
• Based on established computer vision research
limitations:
• Performance affected by 비디오 compression and resolution
• Some methods require sufficient frame count for temporal analysis
• Effectiveness varies with deepfake generation technique
• Best used as part of a comprehensive multi-method pipeline
• May produce false positives on heavily edited authentic 비디오
